name: Guatemala City (Guatemala)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the arms of Guatemala City: a shield showing Saint James on horseback above a volcano.
history: The arms of Santiago de los Caballeros de Guatemala were granted by Queen Juana on 28 July 1532 and show Saint James, the city's patron, above a volcano. The white flag bearing them is used in proportions of about 5:8; no adoption date has been published.

features.role: arms of Guatemala City with Saint James and volcano
